title: Confidence Score (Risk Score)
markdown:
A confidence score is a value between 0 and 100 assigned automatically to threat indicators and represents the confidence that the scoring engine has in that indicator being malicious. A higher score indicates a more malicious indicator.

For more information, see [Intel Exchange Confidence Score Engine](https://techdocs.cyware.com/ctix/en/ctix-confidence-score-engine.html##).
